subject: Copywriting
title: Rules Are Made to Be Broken
description: A quick, practical guide to Rules Are Made to Be Broken.

hook.text: Hopkins said test everything. Bernbach said rules are what artists break. Both were right—at different stages.

buildup.text: Every legend mastered the rules before breaking them. Ogilvy studied Hopkins obsessively, then went his own way.

discovery.text: Bernbach broke every rule of the 1950s: small headlines, long body copy, humor in ads. Each broken rule made history.

twist.text: The legends who only followed rules are forgotten. The ones who broke rules intelligently became immortal.

climax.text: The ultimate lesson: learn everything, then trust your instinct. Copy is part science, part art, part courage.

punchline.text: Learn the rules, then break them wisely. That's how legends are made.

quiz.question: What did every copywriting legend do before breaking the rules?
